page_title: WHU 1-1 BOU | West Ham v Bournemouth 01/02/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+9' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+7' Romain Faivre (Bournemouth) receives a yellow card.
90+6' Substitution. Mohammed Kudus did his best and is replaced by Maxwel Cornet (West Ham).
90+5' Adam Smith (Bournemouth) is disappointed with himself because he got into a good area but produced a poor cross.
90+5' Bournemouth keep possession of the ball with some short passes, waiting for the moment to hit the opposition swiftly on the break.
90+2' 1:5 – the corner kicks stats.
90+1' The substitution is prepared. Romain Faivre (Bournemouth) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Marcus Tavernier.
90' There will be a minimum of 8 min. of added time.
90' Mohammed Kudus (West Ham) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat.
89' The ball spins up and hits the hand of Mohammed Kudus (West Ham) after he fails to control it and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
88' West Ham hold the ball and display nice passing from player to player.
87' Lewis Cook (Bournemouth) launches an inaccurate corner kick into the penalty area.
86' Luis Sinisterra (Bournemouth) shoots from outside the box, but his effort is blocked. The ball goes behind for a corner. Bournemouth will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
85' Justin Kluivert (Bournemouth) sends a cross into the box, but Alphonse Areola comes off his line to gather the ball.
83' Tim Robinson shows a yellow card to Lewis Cook (Bournemouth) for his blatant foul.
83' The current number of shots on target for both teams is 9:8.
82' James Ward-Prowse (West Ham) tries to find Danny Ings, but he puts too much power on the through ball.
81' Justin Kluivert (Bournemouth) breaks past challenges inside the box, but puts too much pace on his pass to Marcus Tavernier.
78' Lloyd Kelly (Bournemouth) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
78' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Milos Kerkez (Bournemouth) is coming onto the pitch as Lloyd Kelly cannot continue after picking up an injury.
78' A player from West Ham commits a rough challenge. Tim Robinson blows for a foul and keeps the game under control.
75' Tomas Soucek (West Ham) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being well blocked by one of the defenders.

75' Marcus Tavernier almost found himself in a promising position after Dominic Solanke (Bournemouth) tried to send a defence-splitting pass, but one of the defenders reacts well and makes a timely interception.
72' Ryan Christie (Bournemouth) sends a chip pass into the box, but Alphonse Areola is quickest to intercept the ball.
70' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) was quite harsh and Tim Robinson didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
68' David Moyes has decided to make a change. Danny Ings (West Ham) replaces Kalvin Phillips.
68' We are about to witness a subsitution. Justin Kluivert (Bournemouth) for Alex Scott.
68' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Antoine Semenyo leaves the pitch and Luis Sinisterra (Bournemouth) comes on.
67' That's a clear yellow card. Ryan Christie (Bournemouth) goes into the book.

66' Ryan Christie (Bournemouth) received a pass and didn't think long what to do with it. He fired a powerful long-range shot which went painfully close to the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for West Ham.
65' Let's have a look at statistics for the fouls committed by both teams – 8:7.
64' The corner from Alex Scott (Bournemouth) is cleared away by the defence.
63' The goalkeeper dives to deny Lloyd Kelly (Bournemouth), whose promising shot was aimed towards the left post. Bournemouth will take a corner kick.
61' 1 - 1 Goal! James Ward-Prowse (West Ham) runs up to the ball, stops and waits for Neto to commit before slotting the penalty into the middle of the goal.
61' James Ward-Prowse (West Ham) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
61' Here comes the VAR decision. YES, it's a penalty!
59' Referee Tim Robinson makes the VAR signal and is going to check whether it’s a penalty. Let’s see what happens!
59' One of the West Ham players is in on goal but gets upended by the defender in the box. That could be a penalty, but the ref says NO! Play continues.
57' Edson Alvarez (West Ham) unleashes a shot from the edge of the box, but it goes straight at Neto.

54' Tomas Soucek (West Ham) reacts well and displays good awareness near the penalty spot to get on the end of a cross from the free kick. He jumps high and produces a header which goes well wide of the left post.
54' Tim Robinson interrupts the game. One of the players from Bournemouth won the ball, but his effort is adjudged unfair. West Ham win a free kick. It's a promising situation for a direct shot.
53' Mohammed Kudus (West Ham) sends over a cross, but he can't find any teammate inside the box. Poor delivery.
52' Some patient build-up play from West Ham as they look to unlock the defence.
50' Alex Scott (Bournemouth) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted.
50' Antoine Semenyo (Bournemouth) attempts to slip the ball through the defence, but is unable to find any of his teammates.
49' Bournemouth are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+3' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+2' There's an opportunity for Alex Scott (Bournemouth) to deliver the ball into the box from a corner.
45+1' Mohammed Kudus (West Ham) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
45' 2 additional min. will be played.
45' Dominic Solanke (Bournemouth) fails to time his run beyond the last defender and the linesman makes a good call by signalling for offside after seeing the whole situation unfold.
44' Tomas Soucek (West Ham) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player.
43' Benjamin Johnson (West Ham) attempted to create a dangerous situation in front of goal by sending a cross into the box, but the defence easily dealt with the threat.
42' Ryan Christie (Bournemouth) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
40' Tomas Soucek (West Ham) storms into the middle of the box and connects with a smart cross from Mohammed Kudus, the keeper is helpless but the header flies just over the bar.
39' Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) escapes his marker to connect with a cross and heads towards the left side of the goal, but the keeper pulls off an excellent save to deny him.

36' A loose ball is pounced on by Antoine Semenyo (Bournemouth) inside the box. He immediately fires in a shot towards the bottom right corner, but Alphonse Areola is alert and makes a comfortable save.
34' Alex Scott (Bournemouth) serves up a nice cross, but Alphonse Areola punches the ball away.
34' James Ward-Prowse (West Ham) takes the free kick and attempts to find some of his teammates inside the box, but the ball is intercepted and cleared out of danger.

33' Alex Scott (Bournemouth) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision! Another situation results in a direct free kick for West Ham.

31' Edson Alvarez (West Ham) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Tim Robinson with no other option than to blow for a foul.
28' Mohammed Kudus (West Ham) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away. The linesman signals a throw-in for West Ham.

27' West Ham are playing possession football and controlling the game at present. They are exchanging inch-perfect passes from player to player, making it difficult for the opposition to win the ball.
25' Marcus Tavernier (Bournemouth) tries to latch onto a through ball, but it's too long.
23' Corner kick. Alex Scott (Bournemouth) is ready to send the ball into the box.
22' Alex Scott (Bournemouth) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball. The referee points to the corner flag and Bournemouth will take a corner.
21' Kalvin Phillips (West Ham) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Tim Robinson no option but to blow his whistle.

19' What a save from Alphonse Areola! Ilya Zabarnyi (Bournemouth) jumps high to meet a cross and glances a promising header from close range, but the goalkeeper pulls off a brilliant stop to keep it out.
18' Alex Scott (Bournemouth) quickly takes the corner kick with a short pass.
18' Antoine Semenyo (Bournemouth) tries his luck from the edge of the box after a brilliant solo effort, but it is well blocked by the defender. Bournemouth win a corner.
16' Kalvin Phillips (West Ham) fires a strong shot to the middle of the goal and the save is unexpectedly difficult for Neto.

15' There's a distinct lack of options for Lewis Cook (Bournemouth), so he drills a shot from long range that curls well wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and West Ham will have a goal kick.
15' Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) slips past one challenge, but is unable to feed a low pass into the path of one of his teammates.
13' James Ward-Prowse (West Ham) takes the corner, but it's intercepted by the defender.

13' James Ward-Prowse (West Ham) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. West Ham will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
11' Benjamin Johnson (West Ham) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear. The referee and the linesman both signal a throw-in for West Ham.
10' Marcus Tavernier (Bournemouth) produces a cunning chipped pass for Alex Scott, who takes it down well but fails to get past the defenders and loses the ball.
8' The Bournemouth players are exchanging short passes in an attempt to create a shooting opportunity.
4' 0 - 1 Goal! A mistake from the defence gifted a chance to a lurking Dominic Solanke (Bournemouth), who keeps his cool and rolls the ball into the net from close range. 0:1.
4' The Bournemouth players halt their celebrations as referee Tim Robinson makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was an offside in the build-up play.
3' Gooal! No wait, it's been ruled out for offside. Dominic Solanke (Bournemouth) disagrees, but the linesman is sure about his call.
1' The first half has just begun.
The players are out and the match is about to start. West Ham will have the kick-off.
Tim Robinson got the nomination for today's game and will try his best to be a fair judge and not make any mistakes.
